Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 104. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the
following benefits:
Wearing medium armor doesn’t impose
disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
When you wear medium armor, you can add 3,
rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of
16 or higher.
